summary: Partner-led customer onboarding journey for Business Central: profiling prospects on a partner website, passing the profile into a personalized trial, loading an AppSource app, and using embedded buying to handle the CSP relationship and go-live. The video describes this as relatively new.
overview:
The video compares the standard trial that starts on dynamics.com with a partner-led onboarding journey. The standard trial does not give content that is as relevant as it could be, and buying requires establishing the CSP relationship first, which adds friction.

In the partner-led approach, the partner profiles the prospect on its own website (industry, business type, current systems) and redirects them to a personalized trial. The profile data is carried through signup and made available in Business Central. The partner can load a relevant AppSource app, build an embedded buying experience, and have customer data such as chart of accounts and posting groups loaded into the new company.
key_points: The standard trial started on dynamics.com is described as not giving content as relevant as it could be.
When a prospect comes through a partner, the partner first has to establish the CSP relationship, load Business Central, apps and configuration, then hand it over. This adds friction.
Partners can profile prospects on their website (industry, type of business, current system such as Excel or a competing product), then redirect them to the signup at dynamics.com.
The standard trial is spun up and an AppSource app chosen by the partner as most relevant is loaded.
The profile outcome from the partner website is carried through the journey and is available in Business Central, so the experience can pivot on customer preferences.
An embedded buying experience can handle the CSP part and take the prospect through onboarding into their own company.
Data such as chart of accounts and posting groups can be loaded dynamically for the new company before go-live.
